plugins.description: Leverj agent skills bundle. Includes: sprint (scrum/kanban workflow on GitHub Projects v2 — issues are requirements, Project fields are state, ADRs in .dev/decisions/); triage (end-to-end triage & fix loop over an epic's sub-issues or a GitHub Projects v2 board — auto-closes dup/wontfix, bundles trivial dep bumps into PRs).
